mapper.select: SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, c.name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, c.maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6) AND c.minimum_order_amount <= #{originalAmount} ORDER BY c.expires_at, mc.id
